### Radical-cure treatment by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Implementation details | Health-system level | Health-system details | Implementation year | Additional safety recommendations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: no definition** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Not implemented | Implemented without G6PD testing for imported cases | Up to community level | Up to community volunteer level | 2016 | Directly Observed Therapy (DOT), adverse event counselling |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Not implemented | Implemented without G6PD testing for imported cases | Up to community level | Up to community volunteer level | 2016 | Directly Observed Therapy (DOT), adverse event counselling |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Implemented | Implemented without G6PD testing for imported cases | Up to community level | Up to community volunteer level | 2016 | Supervision by health professionals (preferably DOT) |
:::
